subject.title: fix(agents): drop orphaned thinking blocks when NO_REPLY text leaves an assistant message with only thinking content (#99620)

question: Should this PR land now as a bounded NO_REPLY mitigation while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99620 remains open for the orphaned-tool-result trigger, or must this branch cover both triggers before merge?
rationale: The patch is a correct narrow mitigation, but repository policy asks one-sided fixes to account for sibling surfaces, and the canonical report explicitly identifies another path to the same permanent replay failure.

options.title: Land bounded mitigation
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks pass, keep the canonical issue open, and require a focused follow-up for the orphaned-tool-result trigger.

options.title: Require complete trigger coverage
options.body: Hold the PR and extend the same replay invariant and regression coverage to the orphaned-tool-result cleanup path before merging.

recommendation.title: Land bounded mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks pass, keep the canonical issue open, and require a focused follow-up for the orphaned-tool-result trigger.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and co-authored the current replay-normalization seam and is the strongest evidenced owner for the scope decision.
